title: Tech View and Board View are offered only at 1024 pixels wide or more
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Make sure the location has the technicians this case uses (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff record is Active, Clockable is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member > enter the first and last name (e.g. Esther Howard), role Technician, Clockable on, Active, enrolled at this location > Save.
  5. Create the work orders this case uses and set their lead technician (e.g. S1-702 led by Esther Howard):
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > choose a customer (e.g. "Fibridge Commercial") and an asset (e.g. unit TRK-118, 2022 Freightliner M2) > Create. Write down the number the build gives the work order (the numbers in this case are examples).
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician (e.g. Esther Howard) and save. Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
  6. Know your screen width (e.g. a 1280 x 800 laptop: a full-screen window is 1280 pixels wide, a window snapped to half the screen is 640). A tablet that can be held sideways is optional.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders full screen.
  2. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (in the design its tooltip reads "Board").
  3. Make the window clearly narrower than 1024 pixels (e.g. snap it to half the screen).
  4. Look at the work orders area and the toolbar.
  5. Make the window full screen again.
  6. Note the display.
  7. Optional: open Work Orders on a tablet held sideways (1024 pixels or wider) and look at the toolbar.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • In the narrow window the page shows List exactly as it does today (the phone card layout) and there is no display switcher.
  • Back at full width the switcher is offered again and the page is in Board View: the narrow window did not change your saved choice.
  • On a sideways tablet of 1024 pixels or wider, Tech View and Board View are offered, the same as on a desktop.
  • The exact 1024-pixel edge cannot be measured by hand: check clearly below and clearly above it and write "edge not checked by hand" in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S1-R14, read 8 Oct 2026. Tech plan revised 24 Sep 2026 (uploaded 8 Oct 2026), section 3.18. Review Decisions 853901313 DR-34.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R14: “The display options follow the same screen-width switch the List uses in production today. On a screen narrower than 1024px, the Work Orders page shows List exactly as it does today (the phone card layout), with no display switcher. At 1024px and wider, Tech View and Board View are offered, whatever the device: a tablet held sideways at 1024px or wider gets them too. The switch is by screen width only; the app never detects the device type.”
  • Tech plan 3.18: “below the desktop breakpoint the mobile List renders and the new displays are withheld, and nothing overwrites the user's desktop choice.”
